name: aivox
description: Connect Codex to a scoped AiVox instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped AiVox tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to AiVox through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so AiVox Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AiVox only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
